content.title: Watch WrestleMania 42: How to stream live this weekend, start time, matchups and betting odds
content.text: WrestleMania 42 starts at 3 p.m. PT on Saturday April 18, and Sunday April 19, 2026.Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe biggest event in professional wrestling gets underway today with the start of WrestleMania 42. This year’s show is another action-packed two-night event, culminating in some exciting events Sunday evening, including the return of Brock Lesnar and CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns. This exciting event begins at 3 p.m. PT/6 p.m. ET (4 p.m. MST) on Sunday, April 19. The entire two-day event is streaming exclusively on ESPN Unlimited, but you can catch one hour a day for free on ESPN2 as a preview. What TV channel is WrestleMania 42 on today? How much does it cost? When does it start?When: 3 p.m. PT/6 p.m. ET (4 p.m. MST) on Sunday, April 19Where: Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, NevadaWWE WrestleMania is available streaming on ESPN Unlimited, ESPN’s standalone streaming service. You must subscribe to ESPN Unlimited to watch this entire event. Plans are priced at $29.99 a month, $299.99 annually for ESPN Unlimited, and $35.99 a month for the Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN Unlimited bundle. Remember to select a plan with ESPN Unlimited to watch this event; it will not be aired on ESPN Select or ESPN Plus.MLB fans can get a free month of ESPN Unlimited by signing up for MLB.TV via ESPN Unlimited. MLB.TV is priced at $29.99 a month or $149.99 for the season. After the free trial, ESPN Unlimited renews at $29.99 a month.Is WrestleMania 42 streaming for free anywhere on Sunday?Yes, WWE fans do have a couple of options to watch an hour of this event each day for free on ESPN2. However, the full event will only be available with a paid subscription to ESPN UnlimitedThe first hour of each event will be on ESPN2 as a preview starting at 3 p.m. PT, and fans can get a couple of different free trials. Check out the comparison below to choose which Service is right for you. All columns visible (no scrolling needed)What are the Lineups for WWE WrestleMania 42? Will there be any guest stars on hand?WWE fans and WrestleMania veterans know that anyone can appear at any time, so there should be lots of surprises and random guests on Saturday and Sunday.
